rationale.purpose: Make approved Settlements work without the full SMP modpack while preserving existing identity, physical inventory, finite currency, native merchant and native NPC ownership contracts.
rationale.decision_source: User approved the standalone design and immediate full implementation on2026-10-17, explicitly making Workers/Recruits optional. Docs/settlements/standalone/README.md and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md own the accepted implementation scope.
user_decisions: Independent Forge1.20.1 installation and integrated-server Settlements
Optional native Workers/Recruits only; no built-in substitutes
Native compact GUI with real state; no Overview/web dashboard
One Gold value per added block; vanilla edible items work
Existing gameplay and authenticated finite economy preserved
codex_implementation_choices: Extract original ABI package closure into one shared runtime Core instead of duplicating classes/state
Jar-in-Jar identical Maven identities and bounded ranges with migrated Economy compatibility floor
Use existing shared wallet/backed cash deposit path for exact Gold-valued area charge
Persist explicit-ID request/session journal and quarantine uncertain mutation outcomes
Separate optional Recruits protocol/handlers and Settlement-owned dish progression from full SMP
Expose retained existing receipt terms without invented transaction timestamps
